title: Create printing setups with explicit unknowns
description: Define and persist a named PrintingSetup whose printer, operating-system, driver, browser, connection, media, and feed metadata distinguishes known values from explicit unknowns.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can create a setup with a non-empty name and save each identifying field as either a validated known value or explicit unknown
Known-empty, known-value, and unknown states cannot be conflated during serialization or reload
The setup survives IndexedDB reload with stable identity, provenance, and unchanged field states
The form is keyboard operable, labels every field, and does not imply automatic hardware discovery

steps.details: Add versioned serializable PrintingSetup and known/unknown field contracts for every PRD-listed identity field, including stable ID, name, provenance, and timestamps.
Add repository create/read behavior and round-trip validation using the existing IndexedDB boundary; reject blank names and malformed field states atomically.
Add semantic controls that require Known or Unknown per field and collect a value only for Known, without browser fingerprinting or inferred printer data.
Add focused contract and keyboard browser tests for mixed known/unknown fields, validation, persistence, and restart recovery.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; use the existing repository, form, and test patterns and do not broaden this task beyond setup identity.
Keep this slice under ten minutes by implementing setup identity only; loading and configuration revisions are separate tasks.
Hardware metadata is user-disclosed local data, not browser inspection or evidence of physical conditions.
